_comment: The startup budget, and the shape of the baseline profile it assumes.
Read by scripts/verify-startup-budget.py, which is the gate. Every number here is a
deliberate decision and the script's docstring says what each one is holding up; this file
carries the values and not the reasoning, because a budget that is edited has to be edited
in one obvious place. docs/baseline-profiles.md is the long form, including how to
These milliseconds are CI emulator milliseconds. They are not a claim about any user's
phone and must not be quoted as one: a software rasteriser on a CPU shared with the rest of
a GitHub runner is roughly an order of magnitude away from real hardware in both directions
depending on the workload. What they are is a regression gate against this repository's own
history, measured the same way every time.
Gated. The API level is what decides how ART treats a baseline profile, so a run on a
different one is not comparable to this budget and fails rather than being measured
against it. ci.yml pins the same number on the emulator.
The device model is deliberately not gated. Emulator images for one API level report
several different model strings, none of which changes what is being measured, so a check
on it would be a flake rather than a guard. The script prints the whole build context it
measured, which is what makes an unexpected machine visible in the log.
